dedupe_keys.name: laboratory testing of a t shaped unbonded post tensioned precast concrete rocking wall

description: Laboratory testing of a T-shaped unbonded post-tensioned precast concrete rocking wall is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Sriram Aaleti, University of Alabama (ua.edu). Precast rocking shear walls with unbonded post-tensioning provide a low damage alternative to traditional monolithic reinforced concrete shear walls. However, laboratory testing of precast rocking shear walls has been limited to rectangular cross-section, despite the widespread use of non-rectangular shear walls in elevator cores or around hallways. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: T-shaped Rocking Wall, Shear Walls, Self-centering, Precast Concrete, Hybrid Wall. Published 2022-11-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
